value.title: Independent Opus review — Copilot native extension

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Read-only code review after PM composition; verify plan promises and seam correctness against actual code and runtime evidence. PM writes plan/guide, coders implement. No source fixes or scope changes. Await explicit PM dispatch with composed SHA before reviewing code.

value.text: Read PM plan, guide, typed backpressure, contracts and prime constraints. Inspect full diff of composed commit against main base46c9314c; distinguish PM document commits from actual code. All paths absolute in PM worktree.

Least confidence: true Copilot host PID/native identity across manual/spawn/new/resume; pane-based consent claim/wake timing; crash after native accept before durable mapping/ack; global installation preservation and foreign path safety. Hunt those first.

DISBELIEVE author receipts: re-derive selected high-risk tests/scenarios independently. Check actual shipping path, not helper-only tests; no hidden pane metadata or Pi harness spoofing. No Copilot sendkeys path including failed-consumer fallback.

Known-open at planning: unrelated file-watch-notify smoke baseline red; npm min-release-age/before git dependency install conflict, existing main node_modules symlink reused read-only. Existing uninstrumented sessions explicitly exempt. Do not duplicate these as new findings; no failure suppression.

Use /builder review discipline and Flowspace3 semantic CLI search/get plus native LSP. Report actual CLI/tool gaps. No code edits, toolchain changes, production peer messages/restarts or global config changes.

Inspect all typed ACs; run focused proof against composed tree after coder edits stop, not project-wide suite repeated unnecessarily. Real manual and Pij-spawned client evidence required; deterministic fixture provider is not real model proof.

Return only material findings (severity, exact location, evidence, affected AC, smallest correction); no_material_findings valid. Write assets/reviews/opus-review.json or ddoc via CLI plus captured evidence. Message PM pij-grim-gurgeh with verdict and pointer; PM will compact you first after terminal verdict.
PM pij-grim-gurgeh owns adjudication and dispatch; unit owners fix upheld findings. Independent evidence outranks any packet assumption.
No plan/guide/code edits or merge/push. Only own assets/reviews files. No modal questions; C10 concise pointer delivery.

value.fence: Read-only code and plan; write only docs/plans/137-copilot-native-extension/assets/reviews/
value.forbidden_note: No .the-flow-state.json, the-flow.json, the-flow.md, plan/guide/backpressure mutations, governance, other branch or global user files.

value.text: Every AC judged with evidence or explicit unavailable proof; no silent substitutions.
Composition/native identity/delivery/consent/installation risks examined and all material findings grounded.
Terminal verdict artifact and path delivered to PM; remain available for focused follow-up.
